key_themes: US-Iran peace deal reopens Strait of Hormuz — oil prices tumble, energy stocks sell off sharply
Trump-brokered Apple-Intel chip manufacturing partnership ignites broad semiconductor rally
Fed aftermath & earnings season: CarMax surges on big beat, Kroger slumps on EPS miss, Accenture craters on weak outlook

Jumped ~11% riding the semiconductor wave from the Apple-Intel partnership news; broader memory/storage sector caught in the rally as tech sentiment surged

Rose ~10% after Barclays upgraded from Underweight to Equal Weight (new PT $51 vs prior $30) citing solid-state transformer opportunity in data centers; also began production shipments of new IQ9S microinverters
Advanced ~7% midday, part of the broader technology infrastructure and photonics rally tied to AI data-center buildout demand
